description: The OCHA COD-PS Jamaica tables (jam_adm0_pop_v2.csv and jam_adm1_pop_v2.csv, source Statistical Institute of Jamaica, reference year 2011, methodology: census) as one Parquet table: 15 rows, one national row (admin_level = 0) and 14 parish rows (admin_level = 1). Columns keep the publisher names: T_TL, F_TL, M_TL and the sex-specific five-year bands T_00_04 to T_65Plus, F_..., M_.... Official children counts for 2011: 977,500 aged 0-19 nationally (T_00_04 + T_05_09 + T_10_14 + T_15_19). Join to the parishes Collection on ADM1_EN = adm1_name (names trimmed), not on P-code. No geometry; a joined spatial version is the parishes Collection. Retrieved from HDX on 2026-09-23 via the CKAN API (package_show cod-ps-jam).
